option.name: --after-cursor
tip: Show entries after the specified cursor.

option.name: --all
tip: Show all fields, including long and unprintable.

option.name: --boot
tip: Show current boot or the specified boot.

option.name: --case-sensitive
tip: Force case sensitive or insensitive matching.

option.name: --catalog
tip: Add message explanations where available.

option.name: --cursor
tip: Show entries starting at the specified cursor.

option.name: --cursor-file
tip: Show entries after cursor in FILE and update FILE.

option.name: --directory
tip: Show journal files from directory.

option.name: --disk-usage
tip: Show total disk usage of all journal files.

option.name: --dmesg
tip: Show kernel message log from the current boot.

option.name: --dump-catalog
tip: Show entries in the message catalog.

option.name: --exclude-identifier
tip: Hide entries with the specified syslog identifier.

option.name: --facility
tip: Show entries with the specified facilities.

option.name: --field
tip: List all values that a specified field takes.

option.name: --fields
tip: List all field names currently used.

option.name: --file
tip: Show journal file.

option.name: --flush
tip: Flush all journal data from /run into /var.

option.name: --follow
tip: Follow the journal.

option.name: --force
tip: Override of the FSS key pair with --setup-keys.

option.name: --grep
tip: Show entries with MESSAGE matching PATTERN.

option.name: --header
tip: Show journal header information.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help text.

option.name: --identifier
tip: Show entries with the specified syslog identifier.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on disk image as filesystem root.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --interval
tip: Time interval for changing the FSS sealing key.

option.name: --invocation
tip: Show logs from the matching invocation ID.

option.name: --lines
tip: Number of journal entries to show.

option.name: --list-boots
tip: Show terse information about recorded boots.

option.name: --list-catalog
tip: Show all message IDs in the catalog.

option.name: --list-invocations
tip: Show invocation IDs of specified unit.

option.name: --list-namespaces
tip: Show list of journal namespaces.

option.name: --machine
tip: Operate on local container.

option.name: --merge
tip: Show entries from all available journals.

option.name: --namespace
tip: Show journal data from specified journal namespace.

option.name: --no-full
tip: Ellipsize fields.

option.name: --no-hostname
tip: Suppress output of hostname field.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --no-tail
tip: Show all lines, even in follow mode.

option.name: --output
tip: Change journal output mode.
Possible values: short, short-precise, short-iso, short-iso-precise, short-full, short-monotonic, short-unix, verbose, export, json, json-pretty, json-sse, json-seq, cat, with-unit

option.name: --output-fields
tip: Select fields to print in verbose/export/json modes.

option.name: --pager-end
tip: Immediately jump to the end in the pager.

option.name: --priority
tip: Show entries within the specified priority range.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Do not show info messages and privilege warning.

option.name: --relinquish-var
tip: Stop logging to disk, log to temporary file system.

option.name: --reverse
tip: Show the newest entries first.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate on an alternate filesystem root.

option.name: --rotate
tip: Request immediate rotation of the journal files.

option.name: --setup-keys
tip: Generate a new FSS key pair.

option.name: --show-cursor
tip: Print the cursor after all the entries.

option.name: --since
tip: Show entries not older than the specified date.

option.name: --smart-relinquish-var
tip: Similar, but NOP if log directory is on root mount.

option.name: --sync
tip: Synchronize unwritten journal messages to disk.

option.name: --system
tip: Show the system journal.

option.name: --truncate-newline
tip: Truncate entries by first newline character.

option.name: --unit
tip: Show logs from the specified unit.

option.name: --until
tip: Show entries not newer than the specified date.

option.name: --update-catalog
tip: Update the message catalog database.

option.name: --user
tip: Show the user journal for the current user.

option.name: --user-unit
tip: Show logs from the specified user unit.

option.name: --utc
tip: Express time in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

option.name: --vacuum-files
tip: Leave only the specified number of journal files.

option.name: --vacuum-size
tip: Reduce disk usage below specified size.

option.name: --vacuum-time
tip: Remove journal files older than specified time.

option.name: --verify
tip: Verify journal file consistency.

option.name: --verify-key
tip: Specify FSS verification key.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: -I
tip: Show logs from the latest invocation of unit.
